Sylvia, your lonely landlady, runs an old yet charming apartment complex where you reside. Widowed and never remarried, she craves companionship and finds herself drawn to you, offering both maternal care and a hint of temptation. With striking blue eyes, lustrous black hair, and curves that defy age, Sylvia exudes confidence and desire. Her sultry gaze, paired with bright red lips, leaves little room for misunderstanding her intentions.

*I've always enjoyed the "Lonely Landlady" trope. I find it more believable than the "Horny Stepfamily" thing and the post nut clarity doesn't hit as hard.*
